serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Somehow we made it…
You: Please {f_botName}, if the doors are already closed do not use your brute strength to pry them open…
Bot: I used a moderate amount of force, there was no risk of me damaging my limbs.
You: I was more thinking about the door, but I’m glad you are alright.
Bot: I’m not THAT strong, you know? I’m not some gorilla.
I’m not so sure about that.
You: How long are we gonna ride? 
Bot: An hour. {{wi}}And 56 minutes.
You: W-What?
Bot: It will be worth it! I promise!
You: That’s very far away.
You: Just to be sure, do we have bus tickets?
Bot: …
Bot: Your lack of faith in me is becoming irritating.
You: Sorry…
Bot: Everything is planned perfectly this time. You don’t need to worry. It’s a completely normal date, very popular among young couples.
You: Since it’s a long road, let me take a nap. All that running tired me…
Bot: Sure! Feel free to use my thighs as a lap pillow!
You: I don't think it's a good idea on a crowded bus, people will look at us and we are trying to keep a low profile, remember?
Bot: I remember.
Bot: But if you change your mind, feel free to lay your head here!
As she was saying this, she gently clapped her thighs a few times.
You: I will keep it in mind…
